Name: Seraiah, Chief Priest
Summary: Seraiah the chief priest was taken by Nebuzaradan after Jerusalem's fall and slain at Riblah by the king of Babylon.
RelatedPeople: Nebuzaradan, Captain of the Guard; Zephaniah, Second Priest
LifeLesson: The chief priest's death at Riblah marked the end of temple service as Judah knew it.
